entry.title: Neuschwanstein Castle

groundCutout.basis: Exact reviewed upper/lower court platform union in signed source-local XZ. Production terrain masking replaces only ground under the retained closed paving/platform; the surrounding ridge and all occupied building footprints are retained. Prevents0.1m-rounded DGM1 samples poking through the reconstructed court plane. Model unload restores terrain; no precinct-wide flattening or alteration of source heights.

terrainReference.basis: Public DGM1-based bare-earth heights, rounded by the service to0.1m and sampled here at3m spacing. Building interiors are interpolated ground, not floor measurements; edge/cliff samples and model footprint approximations remain uncertain. The model uses upper courtY8.2 and lower court/entryY1.0:7.2m difference from open-court samples, withY0 at960.7m DHHN2016 only for this evidence fixture. Production uses the explicit lower-court terrain reference, not an absolute height. The owner section and plan establish the stepped arrangement; architectural heights remain a photographic reconstruction. Host terrain must preserve the local ridge/court profile; coarse Mapzen terrain cannot establish correct contact.

entry.note: Fresh exact-Q4152 precinct and seven distinct occupied ways establish the signed plan; the owner plan and actually inspected south/northwest/court photographs resolve +X111.84° toward the east-southeast gate, +Z201.84° toward Marienbruecke. Individual ranges are fitted independently, without extruding or stretching the precinct. Actually inspected owner complex and Palas section drawings show a lower gate wing and substantial stepped foundations; there are no printed elevation dimensions, so they are used as relative architectural evidence. Bavaria’s public DGM1 height API resolves open upper court968.9m and lower court961.7m DHHN2016:7.2m difference. Correct the upper court edge to the owner plan’s cranked partition nearx39, lower the gateway/connecting range5.5m, replace the former1.7m step by the mapped north stair route and extend embedded foundations toY-7. Use the independently sampled lower-court point[54,1,3.4] as explicit terrain reference. No scaling of the whole ensemble; footprint replacement remains off. The old17m coarse-Mapzen difference is rejected as unsuitable ridge evidence. DGM heights round to0.1m;3m sampling and photo-fitted architectural heights are approximate. Placement is a medium-fi preview requiring host terrain that retains the local ridge profile, not a promise of contact on coarse global terrain. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
